function.name: game_scores_get

function.name: game_rewards_get
function.description: Retrieve information about different types of rewards that you can receive when playing a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

mission.description: The mission for which you want to know the rewards. Default to ''

trophy.description: The trophy level for which you want to know the rewards. Default to ''

function.name: game_missions_list
function.description: List all missions for a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.reasoning: The user wants to find rewards for different missions in Fortnite on PlayStation. We need to call the function game_rewards_get with game="Fortnite", platform="Playstation", mission maybe unspecified or we can ask for mission list first. The user didn't specify a particular mission, so we might list missions first. Use game_missions_list to get missions. Then maybe call game_rewards_get for each mission. But we can ask the user to specify a mission. The user says "尋找在Playstation平台上玩Fortnite時不同任務和獎益的獎勵。" Means "Looking for rewards for different missions and benefits when playing Fortnite on PlayStation." So they want to know rewards for missions. We can provide a list of missions and their rewards. We can call game_missions_list to get missions. Then for each mission, call game_rewards_get. But maybe we can just call game_rewards_get with mission unspecified to get all rewards? The function signature: mission optional. If omitted, maybe returns all? But better to ask for mission list. Let's call game_missions_list.
